answer_text: First, verify on-site network and CMA status: confirm the socket still has connectivity, then in CMA go to Account > License > Bandwidth and ensure the license shows Trial or Commercial (not Scheduled). A Site‑disconnected condition in CMA often points to a license or tunnel issue, so also review CMA’s Site/Tunnel status for any signs of instability. If the issue persists after those checks, gather the troubleshooting results and file a Cato Support ticket with details (affected sockets, related CMA events, any manual upgrade results) and attach console logs if the socket becomes inaccessible.
